steps.name: environment - install runtime and GUI libraries
steps.description: Install minimal system packages required to run tkinter GUIs (python3-venv, python3-tk) and x11-utils when missing. Create a safe /etc/profile.d entry that sets DISPLAY to :99 only if it's unset at shell runtime (non-intrusive). Operates in the workspace /home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/chess-clock-manager-285481-285490/tkniter_chess_clock_native_app. Idempotent: only installs missing packages and preserves apt error visibility.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="${WORKSPACE:-/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/chess-clock-manager-285481-285490/tkniter_chess_clock_native_app}"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
SUDO=""
if [ "$EUID" -ne 0 ]; then SUDO="sudo"; fi
# Only install missing packages. xvfb omitted because a VNC X server is already running (DISPLAY=:99).
MISSING=()
for pkg in python3-venv python3-tk x11-utils; do
  if ! dpkg -s "$pkg" >/dev/null 2>&1; then MISSING+=("$pkg"); fi
done
if [ ${#MISSING[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
  $SUDO apt-get update -qq
  # keep install output visible for failures
  $SUDO DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends "${MISSING[@]}" || { echo "apt-get install failed: ${MISSING[*]}" >&2; exit 2; }
fi
command -v python3 >/dev/null || { echo "python3 missing" >&2; exit 3; }
# Write /etc/profile.d script that sets DISPLAY only if unset at shell runtime
PROFILE=/etc/profile.d/tkniter_chess_clock_env.sh
if [ ! -f "$PROFILE" ]; then
  $SUDO tee "$PROFILE" >/dev/null <<'SH'
# tkniter_chess_clock_native_app environment defaults
# Only set DISPLAY if not already set
if [ -z "${DISPLAY:-}" ]; then
  export DISPLAY=":99"
fi
SH
  $SUDO chmod 644 "$PROFILE"
fi
# Runtime validation: ensure tkinter import works with python3 (exit non-zero on failure)
python3 -c 'import tkinter as tk; assert hasattr(tk, "Tk")' || { echo "tkinter import failed under python3" >&2; exit 4; }

steps.name: dependencies - create venv and install test deps
steps.description: Create a workspace-local virtual environment at .venv and install venv-local setuptools and pytest using explicit venv binaries. Fails fast if python3 -m venv is unavailable. No global pip changes; use venv pip directly.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="${WORKSPACE:-/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/chess-clock-manager-285481-285490/tkniter_chess_clock_native_app}"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
if ! python3 -m venv --help >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "python3 -m venv unavailable; ensure package 'python3-venv' is installed" >&2
  exit 5
fi
# Create venv idempotently
if [ ! -d "$WORKSPACE/.venv" ]; then
  python3 -m venv .venv
fi
VENV_PY="$WORKSPACE/.venv/bin/python"
VENV_PIP="$WORKSPACE/.venv/bin/pip"
if [ ! -x "$VENV_PY" ] || [ ! -x "$VENV_PIP" ]; then
  echo "venv creation failed or venv binaries missing" >&2; exit 6
fi
# Install venv-local tooling; avoid surprising global upgrades
$VENV_PIP install --no-cache-dir --upgrade --quiet pip setuptools pytest || { echo 'venv pip install failed' >&2; exit 7; }
# Verify pytest is importable in venv
$VENV_PY -c 'import pytest' >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'pytest not importable in venv' >&2; exit 8; }

steps.name: validation - build, start, verify GUI app, and stop
steps.description: Ephemeral validation: build/start the GUI app using workspace start.sh (prefers venv python), capture stdout/stderr to validation-logs, verify the process is running, attempt an X snapshot (xwd) or fallback to xdpyinfo, collect evidence (process info, stdout/stderr tails, snapshot if available), then stop the app with a bounded graceful shutdown (SIGTERM then SIGKILL after timeout). By default validation is ephemeral; pass --keep-alive to leave the GUI running for manual VNC inspection. Operates in the workspace path and depends on prior steps.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="${WORKSPACE:-/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/chess-clock-manager-285481-285490/tkniter_chess_clock_native_app}"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
KEEP_ALIVE=false
if [ "${1:-}" = "--keep-alive" ]; then KEEP_ALIVE=true; fi
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/validation-logs"
LOG_STDOUT="$WORKSPACE/validation-logs/app.stdout.log"
LOG_STDERR="$WORKSPACE/validation-logs/app.stderr.log"
export DISPLAY="${DISPLAY:-:99}"
# Verify start script exists and venv or system python available
if [ ! -x "$WORKSPACE/start.sh" ]; then echo 'start.sh missing or not executable' >&2; exit 13; fi
if [ -x "$WORKSPACE/.venv/bin/python" ]; then
  : # prefer venv
elif command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  :
else
  echo 'No python available to run the app' >&2; exit 14
fi
# Start app in background and capture output
"$WORKSPACE/start.sh" >"$LOG_STDOUT" 2>"$LOG_STDERR" &
APP_PID=$!
# give the app a short moment to initialize
sleep 2
if ! ps -p "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Application did not start (pid $APP_PID). See logs: $LOG_STDERR" >&2
  echo '--- STDERR tail ---' >>"$LOG_STDERR" || true
  tail -n 200 "$LOG_STDERR" || true
  exit 20
fi
# Record process info
ps -o pid,ppid,cmd -p "$APP_PID" >"$WORKSPACE/validation-logs/process.info.txt" || true
# Attempt X snapshot: prefer xwd, fallback to xdpyinfo
SNAP="$WORKSPACE/validation-logs/screen.xwd"
if command -v xwd >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if xwd -root -display "$DISPLAY" -silent -out "$SNAP" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "xwd saved to $SNAP" >>"$WORKSPACE/validation-logs/snapshot.log" || true
  else
    echo 'xwd snapshot failed' >>"$WORKSPACE/validation-logs/snapshot.log" || true
  fi
else
  if command -v xdpyinfo >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    xdpyinfo -display "$DISPLAY" >"$WORKSPACE/validation-logs/xdpyinfo.txt" 2>&1 || true
  else
    echo 'No xwd or xdpyinfo available; snapshot skipped' >>"$WORKSPACE/validation-logs/snapshot.log" || true
  fi
fi
# Capture brief tails of logs for evidence
echo '--- STDOUT tail ---' >"$WORKSPACE/validation-logs/log-tails.txt" || true
tail -n 200 "$LOG_STDOUT" >>"$WORKSPACE/validation-logs/log-tails.txt" || true
echo '--- STDERR tail ---' >>"$WORKSPACE/validation-logs/log-tails.txt" || true
tail -n 200 "$LOG_STDERR" >>"$WORKSPACE/validation-logs/log-tails.txt" || true
# If keep-alive requested, leave process running
if [ "$KEEP_ALIVE" = true ]; then
  echo "validation_keep_alive pid=$APP_PID" >"$WORKSPACE/validation-logs/validation.status"
  echo "App left running (pid $APP_PID) for manual VNC inspection. Logs: $LOG_STDOUT $LOG_STDERR"
  exit 0
fi
# ephemeral validation: graceful shutdown with timeout
TERM_TIMEOUT=8
kill -TERM "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
# wait up to TERM_TIMEOUT seconds
for i in $(seq 1 $TERM_TIMEOUT); do
  if ! ps -p "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi
  sleep 1
done
if ps -p "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  kill -KILL "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi
# ensure process reaped
wait "$APP_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
echo 'validation_success' >"$WORKSPACE/validation-logs/validation.status"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="${WORKSPACE:-/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/chess-clock-manager-285481-285490/tkniter_chess_clock_native_app}"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
KEEP_ALIVE=false
if [ "${1:-}" = "--keep-alive" ]; then KEEP_ALIVE=true; fi
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/validation-logs"
LOG_STDOUT="$WORKSPACE/validation-logs/app.stdout.log"
LOG_STDERR="$WORKSPACE/validation-logs/app.stderr.log"
export DISPLAY="${DISPLAY:-:99}"
if [ ! -x "$WORKSPACE/start.sh" ]; then echo 'start.sh missing or not executable' >&2; exit 13; fi
if [ -x "$WORKSPACE/.venv/bin/python" ]; then :; elif command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then :; else echo 'No python available to run the app' >&2; exit 14; fi
# start app in background capturing output
"$WORKSPACE/start.sh" >"$LOG_STDOUT" 2>"$LOG_STDERR" &
APP_PID=$!
sleep 2
if ! ps -p "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Application did not start (pid $APP_PID). See logs: $LOG_STDERR" >&2
  echo '--- STDERR tail ---' >>"$LOG_STDERR" || true
  tail -n 200 "$LOG_STDERR" || true
  exit 20
fi
ps -o pid,ppid,cmd -p "$APP_PID" >"$WORKSPACE/validation-logs/process.info.txt" || true
SNAP="$WORKSPACE/validation-logs/screen.xwd"
if command -v xwd >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if xwd -root -display "$DISPLAY" -silent -out "$SNAP" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "xwd saved to $SNAP" >>"$WORKSPACE/validation-logs/snapshot.log" || true
  else
    echo 'xwd snapshot failed' >>"$WORKSPACE/validation-logs/snapshot.log" || true
  fi
else
  if command -v xdpyinfo >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    xdpyinfo -display "$DISPLAY" >"$WORKSPACE/validation-logs/xdpyinfo.txt" 2>&1 || true
  else
    echo 'No xwd or xdpyinfo available; snapshot skipped' >>"$WORKSPACE/validation-logs/snapshot.log" || true
  fi
fi
# collect log tails
echo '--- STDOUT tail ---' >"$WORKSPACE/validation-logs/log-tails.txt" || true
tail -n 200 "$LOG_STDOUT" >>"$WORKSPACE/validation-logs/log-tails.txt" || true
echo '--- STDERR tail ---' >>"$WORKSPACE/validation-logs/log-tails.txt" || true
tail -n 200 "$LOG_STDERR" >>"$WORKSPACE/validation-logs/log-tails.txt" || true
if [ "$KEEP_ALIVE" = true ]; then
  echo "validation_keep_alive pid=$APP_PID" >"$WORKSPACE/validation-logs/validation.status"
  echo "App left running (pid $APP_PID) for manual VNC inspection. Logs: $LOG_STDOUT $LOG_STDERR"
  exit 0
fi
TERM_TIMEOUT=8
kill -TERM "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
for i in $(seq 1 $TERM_TIMEOUT); do
  if ! ps -p "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi
  sleep 1
done
if ps -p "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  kill -KILL "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi
wait "$APP_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
echo 'validation_success' >"$WORKSPACE/validation-logs/validation.status"
